_comment: Deterministic vulnerability-prioritisation configuration. Every weight and threshold the scorer uses lives here — nothing is hidden in code. Changing a weight changes the ranking and is visible in the exported audit record (config_sha256). Weights are relative; the scorer renormalises over the factors it can actually evaluate, so an unknown CVSS lowers confidence instead of silently scoring 0.

reachability_scale._comment: How exposed the asset is in THIS incident's attack graph.

freshness._comment: Linear decay on the evidence's own document date. Older advisories are not less true, only less urgent as a queue signal.

severity._comment: CVSS base score / 10. CISA KEV publishes no CVSS, so unless the optional NVD enrichment has run this factor is 'unknown' and drops out of the weighted average.

bands._comment: Score is reported with a band because false precision (a 73.4 vs a 71.9) is not defensible from this input data.
